modules.module_title: Follow health and personal hygiene protocols

pcs.pc_description: comply with health and personal hygiene- related protocols as per WHO standards, , revised GMP and ICH GMP guidelines

report any allergy, sickness or any other environment-related breach before or after entering the work premises to the designated person

use helmets, ropes, harness, and ladders while working at heights
use pulleys/ forklift (if available) to transport the material/ spares/ heavy assembly and tools
report any identified breaches in safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
segregate material and follow the 5S system at the storage area
adhere to storage and handling guidelines for hazardous material
identify and correct any hazards that one can deal with safely, competently and within the limits of authority
record the details of completed safety drills and training

inform the concerned person immediately about every unsafe act/ incident
follow emergency procedures efficiently

modules.module_title: Sanitation activities before the start of work

pcs.pc_description: ensure that there is adequate ventilation for the work being carried out
inspect the area and machines to identify cleaning requirements
handle the cleaning material/reagent only after wearing the personal protective equipment required for the cleaning method
clean the area or machine part under supervision as per SOP, in case of any stain on floor or machine
report any additional cleaning requirement, beyond his/her responsibility or skill, to the appropriate person
ensure to get the clearance from the authorized personnel post cleaning validation

segregate, store and dispose of the rejected products or generated waste as per SOP under the supervision

modules.module_title: Segregation and sanitation activities post completion of work

pcs.pc_description: ensure that there is no slippery substance on the floor to avoid slippage
ensure that no scrap/ waste material is lying around
ensure that, on completion of each batch packaging, the area is left clean and dry and meets WHO and cGMP requirements
ensure to get clearance from authorized personnel
dispose off the waste garnered from the activity as per SOP
